description: Start here whenever someone asks for an image, video or music prompt, a photo or film look, or art direction from a description ("a moody product shot of perfume", "rainy cafe at night", "a Suno style for a sad song"): deal one matched card per slot for the job from their plain-language feeling. photo = one image (film, camera, color, light); still = image with title type; cover = album or poster art (film, color, type); video or reel = clip or short (film, camera, color, type, score, light); lyric = lyric video (same as reel); song = music only (score); site = website (film, color, type, web); game = key art, store capsule, sprites, UI and loop music (film, color, type, score); drama = a short drama ad where the ad is the show (film, camera, color, type, score, light, and three shots: hook, twist, payoff); all = every suit. Example: {"feeling": "lonely astronaut on a desert planet at dusk", "job": "video", "shots": 3}. Same seed + same inputs = same hand; a new seed re-deals; hold keeps chosen cards ({"film": "film-gold-200"}). For job drama the hand also carries three shots (hook close-up, twist reveal, payoff wide or push) and the look is dealt from the feeling, with the subject read as the product. Returns the hand (slot to card id and name), the main paste-ready prompt for the job (prompt), why each card was picked, clashes, and a site_url showing the hand with pictures. Show the user the prompt and the site_url; use brief with the hand ids for every block (shot lists, palette, Suno, Midjourney spelling).

aspect.description: Optional frame for the clash check, e.g. "2.39:1" for a film or "9:16" for a reel (default 9:16 for reel and lyric). Pass the same aspect to brief.

feeling.description: The feeling or scene in plain words, e.g. "rainy cafe at night, melancholy". Words after "no"/"not" count against a card. For drama, the story's feeling or situation, e.g. "a quiet breakup at a dinner table".

hold.description: Optional cards to keep, as {slot: card id}, e.g. {"film": "film-gold-200", "score": "score-bossa-nova"}. Slots: type, camera, film, color, score, web, light.

job.description: What the hand is for (default photo); see the job list above.

moods.description: Optional mood chips that weigh more than words. One or more of: cozy, eerie, nostalgic, epic, playful, tense, dreamy, gritty, elegant, kinetic, melancholy, hopeful, futuristic, handmade, serene, bold.

seed.description: Optional integer for a repeatable deal. Omit for a fresh random deal.

shots.description: Optional, for video, reel, lyric or all: also pick a shot list of this many camera cards (the dealt camera first, then matched shots and moves). Pass them all to brief to get one SHOT block each. A drama hand always has 3 (hook, twist, payoff).

subject.description: Optional subject, e.g. "a jazz singer". It is folded into the feeling so scene and person words count. For drama, the product being advertised (used for the setting check, not for picking the look).

name: deal_hand

alternatives.description: slot to other card ids worth a look

error.description: Set instead of the fields above when the input was wrong.

job_used.description: the job the hand was dealt for

prompt.description: the main paste-ready prompt for the job, compiled from this hand (brief gives every block)

block.description: which block, e.g. IMAGE PROMPT, VIDEO PROMPT, SUNO STYLE

text.description: the paste-ready prompt for this hand

shots.description: shot list camera ids when shots was asked

swapped.description: cards swapped to clear a clash

warnings.description: holds or options that could not be honoured
